text:
Maya R: Morning team — quick async standup for KMS/IAM work. Drop what you did yesterday, any blockers, and what you're doing today. Primary focus: key sweep + CVE patch rollout for inference nodes. Ping @infra-team if you need perms or sched.

Sam K: Yesterday: ran keystore sweep across prod/staging, flagged 3 stale keys (svc-payment, svc-telemetry, demo-key). Opened PR #4577 to revoke demo-key and rotate svc-payment. Blocker: cross-account role approval needed from infra to rotate svc-telemetry. Today: follow up with infra, prepare dry-run for eu-west-1.

Priya S: Yesterday: triaged Snyk/SCA alerts; two were false positives, one medium we need to patch. Found rotation script failing when svcaccount token scope is limited. Blocker: missing iam permissions on rotation runner — requested from @leo. Today: update rotation runbook, add CI smoke test to catch svcaccount scope issues.

Leo T: Granted the svcaccount perms for rotation runner and tested rotation locally (happy path). Also noticed KMS replica read error when KV cache tries fallback — filed INF-221 with logs. No blocker for me.

engsec-bot: Automated scan update — nightly CVE scan completed (scan id: scan-2026-03-17-01): 2 HIGH, 7 MEDIUM in prod clusters. Targets: inference-nodes-1, inference-nodes-2. See https://scans.internal/scan-2026-03-17-01

Maya R: Thanks. Two asks: (1) who can own the canary rotation for eu-west-1? Need one lead + oncall shadow. (2) If infra approval for cross-account role is not in by EOD, we postpone that key's rotation.

Sam K: I can lead the eu-west-1 canary. Prefer window 16:00-17:00 UTC to catch US overlap. I'll take oncall shadow from @Leo T if he's available.

Leo T: I can be shadow for the canary and will be oncall at that window. Sam — ping me 10m before start.

Priya S: For the rollout policy, here's the config snippet I plan to use for canary -> full:
```
rollout_policy:
  canary_percentage: 10
  duration_minutes: 20
  metrics:
    - p50_latency
    - error_rate
    - token_cost_delta
  rollback_on:
    error_rate: ">0.5%"
```
Will add smoke test that checks KMS read/write and token validity.

Sam K: Looks good. One more note: PR #4577 includes the rotation playbook and required infra ACL changes. @infra-team please review ACL change for cross-account role so we can proceed.

infra-team: Ack — will review ACLs in the next hour, ETA for approval ~2h. If anything blocks, we'll post here.

Maya R: Great. If infra approves, we aim to start dry-run at 16:00 UTC. If not, we'll reschedule. Also tagging @engsec-bot to run a targeted CVE scan pre-rollout. :thumbsup:

engsec-bot: Scheduled targeted CVE scan for inference-nodes-1 at 15:20 UTC (scan id: scan-2026-03-17-01a).

Maya R: Cool — thanks everyone. If no major blockers by 15:30 UTC I'll kick off the canary. Otherwise keep updates here.

Sam K: Ack. I'll post post-mortem notes in PR after dry-run.

Priya S: I'll update the runbook and link the smoke test to the PR.

Leo T: Ready to shadow.

Maya R: Closing the async thread — follow up in PRs and ping if anything urgent. :rocket:
